methodologyNotes: Products selected as notable 24V low-voltage smart thermostats (plus one mini-split and one high-voltage specialist) a buyer compares in 2026, covering budget through premium tiers. Seeds from prompt verified and expanded to 13 products. Primary sources: manufacturer product pages (ecobee.com, wyze.com, honeywellhome.com, getmysa.com, sensi.copeland.com), Wikipedia (Nest Learning Thermostat article for generation/release-date data), SafeWise review blog (safewise.com/blog/best-smart-thermostats), and HowToGeek (howtogeek.com) for corroboration. Google Store pages consistently served truncated JS-rendered content; specs cross-confirmed via Wikipedia, SafeWise, and 9to5Google search snippets. Amazon.com consistently returned 5xx errors; Amazon Smart Thermostat specs sourced from SafeWise review. Honeywell T9/T10 Pro verified via honeywellhome.com product pages (both now discontinued/sold out). priceUsd is US MSRP at time of research (2026-06-15) or launch MSRP where current page shows 'sold out'. Mysa prices are listed in CAD on manufacturer site; USD equivalents at parity noted as null with explanation. accessedAt = 2026-06-15 for all sources.

products.name: Google Nest Learning Thermostat (4th Gen)

specs.display: 2.68-inch circular stainless-steel framed display with Farsight (activates when motion detected), 3.9-inch diameter body
specs.sensors_included: Temperature, humidity, occupancy (60 GHz Soli radar), ambient light; up to 6 additional Nest temperature sensors supported
specs.hvac_compatibility: Most 24V systems: single- and multi-stage forced air (gas/oil/electric), heat pumps (1-3 stage heating, 1-2 stage cooling), radiant, hydronic, boilers; not compatible with communicating HVAC systems
specs.voice_assistants: Google Assistant (built-in via Google Home app), Amazon Alexa, Matter

products.provenance: Wikipedia confirms 4th gen released August 20 2024, 2.68-inch display, 3.9-inch diameter, Soli radar occupancy sensor. SafeWise confirms $279.99 MSRP and no C-wire required. HVAC compatibility and voice assistant details from Wikipedia article and Google's publicly documented compatibility (Alexa, Google Assistant, Matter). Farsight feature documented across multiple review sources. Energy history (Nest Home Report) confirmed from SafeWise and Wikipedia.

products.provenance: CORRECTED 2026-06-17: priceUsd changed from 79.99 to 59.99. Manufacturer MSRP is $59.99/$60 (Amazon announced it at $60 with Honeywell Home on Sept 28 2021 per Bloomberg; Bob Vila 2026 review and multiple ENERGY STAR utility marketplace listings list ~$60). Amazon.com product page is JS-rendered and could not be fetched directly; specs cross-referenced from Bloomberg, Bob Vila, utility marketplace listings, and Smart Thermostat Guide review.
